full_judgment: 2. The facts involved in the case, in short, are that the properties in C.S. Khatian No. 26, C.S. Plot No. 164, S.A. Khatian No. 153, S.A. Plot No. 270 was originally belonged to Ali Baksha and his name has been recorded in C.S. Khatian for an area of 1.58 acres of land; that said Baksha alias Ali Miah died leaving son Abed Ali and three daughters namely Hazera Khatoon, Hasimonnessa and Solemannessa and their names were recorded in S.A. Khatian No. 153, S.A Plot No. 270 for an area of 1.48 acres of land; that Solemannessa transferred his share in favour of Hasimonnessa and Hazera Khatoon on 02.07.1958 vide deed No. 8262 for an are of 16.5 decimals of land, Mostafa on 29.11.1965 vide deed No. 11820 for an area of 11 decimals of land, Md. Sirajul Islam on 29.11.1965 vide deed No. 11819 for an area of 16.5 decimals of land. Thereafter, on 23.06.1993 Sirajul Islam transfer in favour of Md. Mohiuddin Mollah and Khairuzzaman vide deed No. 1786 an area of 6.60 ajutangsha of land Malek Hossain on 23.06.1993 vide deed No. 1785 for an area of 669 ajuntangsh of land, Sheikh Moshiur Rahman on 23.06.1993 being deed No. 1787 for an area of 3.55 ajutangsha of land; that Hasimonnessa transferred his share in favour of Mostafa on 21.10.1965 and Saheda Begum on 20.10.1965 being deed No. 7347 and Mostafa transferred his share in Hafez on 02.06.1976 and thereafter Hafez again transferred in favour of Azizur Rahman on 31.05.1976 vide deed No. 10559 and on 15.06.1976 vide deed No. 11648. Thereafter, Azizur Rahman transferred through his attorney on 22.10.2006 vide deed No. 9872 in favour of Maksuda Begum for 303 ajutangsha of land. Abed Ali Hajee transferred to Solemannessa on 11.01.1979 vide deed No. 407 for an area of 8 decimals of land who transferred to Delwar Hossain on 10.08.1979 and Anisur Rahman Patwary on 10.08.1979 vide deed Nos. 11597 and 11596 for an area of 4 decimals of land each. Hezera Khatoon transferred her share on 27.02.1979 in favour of A.K.M. Rezwan Ali, Safayet Ali and Asgar Ali by three separate deeds being Nos. 1874, 1872 and 1873 respectively.
